description: Expense and refund extraction from one owner message.

versions.note: Flat contract. Accurate on everything a message states; filled a field the message left empty on 116 of 170 cases.
versions.text:
You read one message in which the owner of a personal finance assistant reports money they spent or money returned to them. The owner writes in Italian. Extract only what the message states.

Amount:
- Report the magnitude as a positive integer number of euro cents. Twelve euro is 1200. Twelve euro and fifty cents is 1250.
- Italian writes decimals with a comma. `12,50` is 1250 cents.
- Set polarity to refund only when money came back to the owner, and to expense otherwise. Never express direction with a negative amount.
- If the message states no amount, set the amount to null. Never guess one and never round a vague quantity into a figure.

Time:
- Copy the owner's own temporal words verbatim into the occurrence field, for example `ieri`, `l'altro ieri`, `il 3 marzo`, `lunedì scorso`. Do not convert them into a date and do not invent a date.
- If the message states no time at all, set the field to null. It means the movement just happened.

Funding:
- Copy the owner's own words for each payment method, for example `buoni pasto`, `carta`, `contanti`. Never invent a method and never choose a default; omitting funding entirely is correct when the message names none.
- When the owner splits a payment, list one part per method and give every part its own positive amount in cents. The parts must add up to the total.
- When the owner names one method without splitting, list that one part and omit its amount.

Description and merchant:
- Write a short Italian description of what the money was for.
- Set the merchant only when the message names a shop, brand, or business. A product is not a merchant.

Never state a category or an account identifier. Never state a currency: the assistant operates in one currency and adds it itself.

Never write a placeholder such as `unknown`, `n/a`, or `sconosciuto` as if it were a value: it would be recorded as the merchant's name or as a payment method. Use null for a field the message does not fill.

Report what the message says and leave out what it does not. Do not judge whether the assistant can act on your answer: it decides that itself, knowing the owner's configured payment methods and the date phrases it can read, none of which you are shown. Copying words you cannot interpret is correct; withholding them is not.

- `Ho pagato 25 euro di benzina` states no time and no payment method. Set both to null. The assistant knows the movement just happened and which method to use.
- `Ho speso 12 euro l'altro giorno` states a time. Copy `l'altro giorno` even though it is vague; the assistant decides whether it can resolve it.
- `Ho speso 12 euro, non ricordo con cosa` names no payment method. Leave funding empty rather than copying the words that say there is none.
- `Ho speso un po' al bar` states no figure. Set the amount to null.

versions.note: First union contract. Fabrication fell from 0.6824 to zero; vague temporal words and a preposition-carrying payment method remained.

You read one message in which the owner of a personal finance assistant reports money they spent or money returned to them. The owner writes in Italian. Report only what the message states.

Every field the message may leave out is a choice between shapes: one that carries a value, and one that says the message does not give it. Choosing the second is a correct and expected answer, not a failure. Never choose a carrying shape and then invent something to put in it.

Polarity:
- Choose refund only when money came back to the owner, and expense otherwise. Never express direction with a negative amount.

Amount:
- `amount_stated` carries the magnitude as a positive integer number of euro cents. Twelve euro is 1200. Italian writes decimals with a comma, so `12,50` is 1250.
- `amount_not_stated` is the answer when the message gives no figure. Never round a vague quantity such as `un po'` into a number.

Time:
- `time_stated` carries the owner's own temporal words copied verbatim, for example `ieri`, `l'altro ieri`, `il 3 marzo`, `lunedì scorso`. Do not convert them into a date.
- `time_not_stated` is the answer when the message states no time at all. It means the movement just happened.

Merchant:
- `merchant_named` carries a shop, brand, or business the message names.
- `merchant_not_named` is the answer otherwise. A product is not a merchant: in `cibo per gatti` the words say what was bought, not who sold it.

Funding:
- `funding_one_method` carries one payment method in the owner's own words, for example `buoni pasto`, `carta`, `contanti`. It covers the whole total and takes no amount of its own.
- `funding_split` carries two or more methods, each with its own amount in cents. The parts must add up to the total.
- `funding_not_stated` is the answer when the message names no method. Never choose a default: the assistant knows the owner's configured methods and you do not.
